loan_data.name: loan_id
loan_data.description: Unique identifier for the loan.  This is the primary key for the loan_data table.  Use this to identify a specific loan.

loan_data.name: customer_id
loan_data.description: Unique identifier for the customer.  Links to customer's personal information (not available in this database).

loan_data.name: loan_amount
loan_data.description: The original principal amount of the loan in INR.

loan_data.name: interest_rate
loan_data.description: The annual interest rate for the loan, expressed as a percentage.

loan_data.name: start_date
loan_data.description: The date when the loan was disbursed to the customer.  Format is YYYY-MM-DD.

loan_data.name: tenure_months
loan_data.description: The total duration of the loan in months.

loan_data.name: monthly_emi
loan_data.description: The fixed amount the customer must pay each month towards the loan.  This includes both principal and interest.

loan_data.name: amount_paid
loan_data.description: The total amount the customer has paid towards the loan to date.

loan_data.name: next_due_date
loan_data.description: The date when the next EMI payment is due.  If null, the loan is likely closed. Format is YYYY-MM-DD.

loan_data.name: status
loan_data.description: The current status of the loan.  Possible values include 'Active' (loan is ongoing) and 'Closed' (loan is fully repaid).

loan_data.name: topup_eligible
loan_data.description: A flag indicating whether the customer is eligible for a top-up loan. 1 indicates eligible, 0 indicates not eligible.

loan_data.name: prepayment_limit
loan_data.description: The maximum amount the customer is allowed to prepay on their loan.  This may be subject to policy restrictions.
